compiler_only_output.reason: mwccarm emits the complete-object constructor beside the licensed base-object C2 at 0x020c4048 whenever the constructor is written as a real method. No ov006 symbols.txt row configures a C1 home for this class, and no surviving relocation in this TU reaches one, so production isolation drops it -- the same disposition arm9/ActorBase takes for _ZN7fBase_cC1Ev.

The constructor naturally emits this class's vtable storage; the cartridge's own copy is configured at ov006 0x0213afd8 (config/arm9/overlays/ov006/symbols.txt). romdata_check compares the emitted payload against those cartridge words before text-only isolation discards it.

Type-name string dragged in beside the vtable; the cartridge configures it at ov006 0x0213afe4. The class carries the cartridge's own RTTI spelling (not a coined name), so the record resolves and is word-compared rather than dropped unverified.

Plain class RTTI record for this class with no base, emitted beside the vtable. The cartridge configures it at ov006 0x0213b000; its first word relocates to arm9 0x0209a774 (_ZTVN3abi17__class_type_infoE), not the single-inheritance type-info vtable. romdata_check verified the emitted 8-byte record equal to the cartridge before isolation.

Vector3's empty destructor from include/types.h, dragged in by the Vector3 locals of the front helpers. It HAS a ROM home -- arm9:0x020072c0, kind:function(arm,size=0x4) in config/arm9/symbols.txt -- owned by another source, so this object's copy is a vague-linkage duplicate rather than compiler-only output. rombuild proves the body against the cartridge before discarding it.

Base-object constructor emitted beside C1 by the out-of-line Heyho::Heyho(). The cartridge carries only C1 at 0x020c6f70 (size 0x1c), the last function of the unit, and Heyho is only ever constructed as a complete object (the dScMgJump_c / dScMgJump2_c arrays), so C2 has no ROM home. Homeless and unreferenced, so a plain deadstrip.

Base-object destructor emitted beside D1 by the out-of-line Heyho::~Heyho(). The cartridge carries only D1 at 0x020c6f3c (size 0x34), followed directly by C1 at 0x020c6f70, so the image has no room for a D2. Homeless and unreferenced, so a plain deadstrip.
